derivation.sql: select count(*) from (select contract_award_unique_key, sum(federal_action_obligation) as net from snapshot group by contract_award_unique_key) where net < 0

values.description: Sum of the negative transaction obligations (de-obligations) in the period

derivation.sql: select sum(federal_action_obligation) from snapshot where federal_action_obligation < 0

values.description: Net obligations divided by the awards active in the period

derivation.sql: select sum(federal_action_obligation), count(distinct contract_award_unique_key) from snapshot

values.description: Share of net obligations held by the 10 largest recipients at the reporting level (parent UEI, else the recipient's own UEI; ADR-0002)

derivation.sql: with by_reporting as (select coalesce(recipient_parent_uei, recipient_uei) as reporting_uei, sum(federal_action_obligation) as net from snapshot group by 1), ranked as (select net, row_number() over (order by net desc, reporting_uei) as rank from by_reporting) select (select sum(net) from ranked where rank <= 10), (select sum(federal_action_obligation) from snapshot)

values.description: Net obligation in the period of the award with the lowest net obligation

derivation.sql: select contract_award_unique_key, sum(federal_action_obligation) as net from snapshot group by contract_award_unique_key order by net, contract_award_unique_key limit 1
